module_summary: One stage of a loadable shift register: flop Q loads R when L, else shifts in w when E, else holds.

anchors.name: Q
anchors.why: Shift-register stage bit; output to next stage.

anchors.name: L
anchors.why: Load enable; has priority and selects parallel value R into Q.

anchors.name: E
anchors.why: Shift enable; loads previous-stage bit w into Q.

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: Serial input from previous shift stage.

anchors.name: R
anchors.why: Parallel load value for this stage.

groups.name: shift_stage
groups.description: Priority mux load/shift/hold feeding the stage flop Q.
